permissions.description: Identifies PromptBranch CLI publication, which sends an immutable prompt snapshot to the configured sharing portal. PromptBranch also performs its own confirmation and secret scan; this rule supplies the outer agent-launch boundary, including non-interactive `--yes` execution.
permissions.label: PromptBranch prompt publication
safer_guidance: Run promptbranch publish --preview and review the exact payload and destination first.
Approve the exact prompt and portal in an interactive terminal before publishing.

permissions.description: Identifies PromptBranch CLI import, which fetches a shared snapshot from a portal and creates a new local prompt from that untrusted content.
permissions.label: PromptBranch shared prompt import
safer_guidance: Open the share URL in a browser and review its prompt, tags, and history before importing.
Import into an isolated PromptBranch database first when testing an untrusted share.

permissions.description: Identifies PromptBranch CLI add-note, which persists a note on a local prompt or prompt version.
permissions.label: PromptBranch prompt note write
safer_guidance: Review the target prompt and exact note body before writing them to the shared local library.

permissions.description: Identifies PromptBranch CLI report-run, which persists run metadata and evaluation results locally.
permissions.label: PromptBranch prompt run report
safer_guidance: Confirm the prompt version, tool, model, rating, and summary before recording the run.

permissions.description: Identifies PromptBranch CLI suggest, which creates a local branch and pending prompt version for later human review.
permissions.label: PromptBranch prompt suggestion write
safer_guidance: Review the target prompt, complete rewritten content, and rationale before creating the suggestion.

action_classes: PromptBranch prompt suggestion local file read command
permissions.description: Identifies PromptBranch CLI suggest --file, which reads caller-selected local file content before storing it in a pending prompt version.
permissions.label: PromptBranch prompt suggestion file read
safer_guidance: Review the selected file path and its complete contents before creating the suggestion.
